description: Local append-only friction ledger for coding agents: capture meaningful failures and findings, review recurrence, and verify fixes.
rules: Use blotter schema for the installed CLI contract; the Rust library is not a supported public API.
The package is blotter-cli and the executable is blotter. Install only with authorization.
Capture qualifying repository-local friction without running list first; independent recurrences are evidence.
A cut needs transferable, consequential, recurring, misleading, or systemic value. Skip ordinary execution noise.
Dogears are observed findings, not generic ideas or backlog tasks. Never invent evidence.
Triage and retrospect are read-only. Only record a promotion for an approved durable artifact that exists.
Use current impact and disposition fields. Do not recommend the retired hook or automatic capture lane.
Review secrets before sharing logs; best-effort redaction and doctor --leaks are not confidentiality guarantees.
